interface.signature: def criticalConnections(V: int, adj: List[List[int]]) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: V is an integer representing the number of vertices and is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and len(adj) == V and all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: adj is a list of lists where each sublist contains the neighbors of the corresponding vertex.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(edge, list) and len(edge) == 2 for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of lists, where each sublist contains exactly two integers representing an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= edge[0] < V and 0 <= edge[1] < V for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each edge contains valid vertex indices within the range [0, V-1].

postconditions.expression: all(edge[0] < edge[1] for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each edge is represented in sorted order, i.e., the first vertex index is less than the second vertex index.

postconditions.expression: all(edge in adj[edge[0]] and edge in adj[edge[1]] for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each edge in the return value is present in the adjacency list of both its vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(edge[0] != edge[1] for edge in return_value) and all(edge[0] != edge[1] for edge in adj[i]) for i in range(V))
postconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself, and no self-loops are present in the adjacency list.

postconditions.expression: all(all(edge[0] != edge[1] for edge in return_value) and all(edge[0] != edge[1] for edge in adj[i]) for i in range(V))
postconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself, and no self-loops are present in the adjacency list.

postconditions.expression: all(edge in return_value if edge in critical_edges else edge not in return_value for edge in [(i, j) for i in range(V) for j in adj[i] if i < j])
postconditions.description: The return value contains all and only the critical connections in the graph.
